items: Comparison of two different numbers within a relative 1e-13 of each other (under Fast)
Comparison of any two different numbers under Exact (for example =1<2 and =A5<1)
not_ported.reason: Refused with NotImplemented under Fast: Excel compares some nearly equal numbers as equal, by a rule that is not modelled. The band of a relative 1e-13 (NEAR in crates/calc-func/src/catalogue/comparison.rs) only marks which pairs are refused; Excel's rule, and with it the band's true width, is cdoc-jpha's. Under Exact, telling any two different numbers apart runs the near-equality test, which rounds, so every comparison of two different numbers is refused with ExactUnavailable, not only pairs within the band. Ordering the operands before the band is applied, or routing the test by numeric mode, is cfunc-m3.22's (numeric-mode routing); the band itself is cdoc-jpha's.
not_ported.basis: near-equal, nearly equal, near-equality (cdoc-jpha); tolerance hits cfunc-m3.11 (regression functions) and cfunc-m7.2 (Fast-mode tolerance contracts for acceptance), neither of which models the comparison operators; 15 significant has no hit

items: The near-zero adjustment of + and -: Excel may give 0 for a + or - result near zero when that operation is the formula's final one (=0.5-0.4-0.1 against =1*(0.5-0.4-0.1))
